title: Straight Outta Compton
tagline: The world's most dangerous times created the world's most dangerous group.
about: Five young men from Compton form N.W.A in 1986, change rap music, and then come apart over contracts and money.
cue: Serve the coney dogs when N.W.A play the banned song in Detroit anyway.

Eazy admits he likes Afterschool Specials. Warm peach cobbler with vanilla ice cream.

    StartersBread and butter fried chicken slidersCube tells Dre he's their bread and butter. Buttermilk fried chicken with bread and butter pickles.How to make it600g chicken thigh fillets, cut in pieces250ml buttermilk150g plain flour2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp cayenne pepper1 L vegetable oil, for frying8 soft slider rolls1/2 cup bread and butter pickles4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt.Toss in the flour seasoned with the paprika and cayenne until shaggy.Fry in oil at 170°C until deep golden and cooked through.Fill the rolls with mayo, chicken and pickles.Ruthless Records chilli cheese friesEazy puts up the money for Ruthless. Crinkle-cut fries under beef chilli and melted cheddar.How to make it750g frozen crinkle-cut fries400g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin400g tin crushed tomatoes150g cheddar, grated3 spring onions, slicedBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Brown the mince and onion, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick.Pile the fries on a tray, spoon over the chilli and scatter with cheese.Grill until melted and finish with spring onion.Corn chips and hot salsa for the studioFor the long nights making the album.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Off the GrillCompton carne asada tacosHome turf in Compton in 1986. Charred skirt steak, salsa verde and onion on corn tortillas.How to make it700g skirt steak3 limes1 orange3 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp olive oil12 small corn tortillas250ml salsa verde1 white onion, finely diced1 cup coriander, choppedMarinate the steak in the juice of 2 limes and the orange with the garlic, cumin, oil and salt.Grill over high heat, 3 minutes a side, rest it, then chop small.Warm the tortillas on the grill.Top with steak, salsa verde, onion and coriander, with lime wedges.Detroit show coney dogsThe group plays the banned song in Detroit. Beef franks, chilli, mustard and raw onion.How to make it8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls300g beef mince1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp tomato paste4 tbsp yellow mustard1 white onion, finely dicedBrown the mince, breaking it up finely, then add the spices, tomato paste and a cup of water and simmer until saucy.Grill the franks until blistered.Warm the rolls, add the franks and spoon over the chilli.Finish with mustard and raw onion.Sweet StuffAfterschool Special peach cobblerEazy admits he likes Afterschool Specials. Warm peach cobbler with vanilla ice cream.How to make it2 x 825g tins of sliced peaches, drained150g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon1 tbsp cornflour200g self-raising flour80g cold butter, diced150ml buttermilk500ml vanilla ice creamToss the peaches with half the sugar, the cinnamon and cornflour in a baking dish.Rub the butter into the flour and the rest of the sugar, then stir in the buttermilk.Drop spoonfuls over the peaches and bake at 190°C until golden and bubbling.Serve warm with ice cream.Cold DrinksAftermath watermelon agua frescaDre walks away to start Aftermath. Watermelon, lime and mint over ice.How to make it1kg seedless watermelon, cubed2 limes2 tbsp caster sugar500ml cold water1/2 cup mint leaves2 cups ice cubesBlend the watermelon with the lime juice, sugar and water until smooth, then strain.Pour over ice and mint in 4 tall glasses.A cold forty of malt liquorBrown paper bag on request.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
